source_strategy: GBIF images from exact source scientific determinations only, with individual CC licensing and basic pixel checks; store creator/source. Existing Joey and Glass Root Garden catalogs remain available but have separate individual rights/ID requirements.
guardrails: Skip any canonical taxon no longer holding exactly one gallery record
Respect outstanding photo/genus claims and curation inbox; do not edit other lanes
Do not alter science, taxonomy, nativity, source identities or old image credits
Do not label selected image as depicting target structure until personally viewed
No annotations/arrows without visible validated target
No changes to five scheduled automations; run one one-time GitHub workflow
